```python
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv(DATASET_PATH)
adj = pd.read_csv(ADJACENCY_PATH)

# Self-containment ratios
trip_boroughs = sorted(df['StartBorough'].unique())
departures = df.groupby('StartBorough').size()
self_contained = df[df['StartBorough'] == df['EndBorough']].groupby('StartBorough').size()
ratios = pd.DataFrame({'departures': departures, 'self_contained': self_contained}).fillna(0)
ratios['ratio'] = ratios['self_contained'] / ratios['departures']
ratios = ratios.reindex(trip_boroughs)
print("Ratios:")
print(ratios[['ratio']])

# Build symmetric neighbor set for the 11 boroughs
borough_set = set(trip_boroughs)
neighbors = {b: set() for b in trip_boroughs}
for _, row in adj.iterrows():
    b = row['borough']
    n = row['neighbor']
    if b in borough_set and n in borough_set:
        neighbors[b].add(n)
        neighbors[n].add(b)

print("\nNeighbor degrees:")
for b in trip_boroughs:
    print(b, len(neighbors[b]), sorted(neighbors[b]))

# Construct row-standardized weights matrix
N = len(trip_boroughs)
W = np.zeros((N, N))
for i, b in enumerate(trip_boroughs):
    deg = len(neighbors[b])
    if deg > 0:
        for j, n in enumerate(trip_boroughs):
            if n in neighbors[b]:
                W[i, j] = 1.0 / deg
    else:
        W[i, :] = 0.0

print("\nW matrix row sums:", W.sum(axis=1))

# Moran's I
x = ratios['ratio'].values
z = x - np.mean(x)
den = np.sum(z**2)
num = np.dot(z, np.dot(W, z))
I_obs = num / den
print("\nObserved Moran's I:", I_obs)

# Permutation test: shuffle ratios across boroughs, keep W fixed
np.random.seed(42)
n_perm = 1000
I_perm = np.empty(n_perm)
for p in range(n_perm):
    z_perm = np.random.permutation(z)
    num_perm = np.dot(z_perm, np.dot(W, z_perm))
    I_perm[p] = num_perm / den

# One-tailed p-value for positive autocorrelation
p_value = np.mean(I_perm >= I_obs)
print("Permutation p-value (one-tailed, positive):", p_value)
print("Mean permuted I:", np.mean(I_perm))
print("Min permuted I:", np.min(I_perm))
print("Max permuted I:", np.max(I_perm))
```
